<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the only signals in the typical methyl region (~10‑30 ppm) are at 26.90 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent methyl carbons) and 26.18 ppm (one methyl carbon). This gives a total of three CH₃ groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
